# M2: who the population excludes (auto-generated by `python -m scout.data.excluded`)

36,459 candidate snapshots 2013–2024 (any league minutes in the 7 leagues the previous season, club in those leagues on 1 Sep, valued). Shares are of candidates. The last column shows the value change the model never learns from: fringe players (< 450 min) who were revalued.
